title: C: Dynamic Array
description: Implement a dynamic integer array using malloc/realloc that grows automatically as elements are added.

steps.title: DynArray Init and Append
steps.description: Define a `DynArray` struct with `int *data`, `int size`, `int capacity`. Write `void da_init(DynArray *da)` that allocates initial capacity of 4. Write `void da_append(DynArray *da, int val)` that reallocs when full. Test by appending 6 numbers and printing them.
hints: When size == capacity, double capacity with `realloc`.
